sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm – proposal for full allocation from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation and for explaining the current capacity situation. We would like to secure full allocation through a firm commitment, and propose: EUR 29.89/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, a 24-month term and 42 days lead time, with payment at 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); we do not assert that this is your actual cost or margin.

Could you let us know what package would allow you to secure full allocation at this price? If it requires internal approval, we would be glad to support your business case with any information you need.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm – proposal for full allocation from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We reviewed your request for a full allocation of 23,400 units and a reduced lead time of 42 days. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Accommodating this shorter lead time and higher volume within our current production schedule requires significant adjustments. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Consequently, we can offer this specific package at a price of €33.60 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Revised package: full allocation, 36 months, 56 days
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation. We understand that delivering full volume at 42 days would require significant changes to your current production schedule. We would like to ease that constraint rather than add to it.

We therefore propose a complete package of EUR 30.90/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, a 36-month term and 56 days lead time. Payment remains 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01. This moves us in three ways:
- We raise our proposed price from EUR 29.89.
- We add a third committed year.
- We accept 56 days lead time instead of the 42 days we requested, giving you more scheduling room.

Would this longer, firmer commitment allow you to set the unit price at EUR 30.90 for full allocation? If internal approval is needed, we would be glad to support your business case.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Revised package: full allocation, 36 months, 56 days
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your revised parameters of 36 months and 56 days lead time, which provide better planning stability. Consequently, we can offer a unit price of EUR 31.50 for this specific package. Our offer stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

Please provide the data supporting your volume projections for the requested full allocation. Which volume can you commit to? Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
